description: This file defines a final class RequestOptions containing constants for various built-in Guzzle HTTP request options. It serves as a reference or helper for setting and referring to request options within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: RequestOptions
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates constants representing different request options available in Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: Constants for request options
methods.description: Contains constant identifiers for various HTTP request options such as allow_redirects, auth, body, headers, etc.
